name: services/mailclient/update_recipients_group
description:
Update a recipients group.

Remember to call refresh_recipients method after executing this method or you will not be able to send the message.

This method works only with messages with status draft.

arguments.name: primary_group_ids
arguments.description: List of primary group IDs that are part of this group.

arguments.name: custom_group_ids
arguments.description: List of custom group IDs that are part of this group.

arguments.name: user_ids
arguments.description: List of user IDs that are part of this group.

arguments.name: emails
arguments.description: List of email addresses that are part of this group.

arguments.name: strict
arguments.description: Should a nonexistent object referenced by primary_group_ids, custom_group_ids or user_ids argument cause an error? If set to false, all invalid references will be silently discarded.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
An empty dictionary returned if the method has been executed successfully.
    Some keys may be added in the future.
errors:
• object_invalid - message is in invalid state.

    Possible reasons:

    • draft_required - message is not a draft.

  • object_not_found - custom group could not be found; param_name is equal to custom_group_ids;

  • object_not_found - message could not be found; param_name is equal to message_id;

  • object_not_found - primary group could not be found; param_name is equal to primary_group_ids;

  • object_not_found - user could not be found; param_name is equal to user_ids.
